scope: Current dancer AMP, standard K1, fifa7vs7, --bhuman-physics (2 ms Euler), inference/network 20 ms
conclusion_zh: 只提高前进 command 确实可提速；完整客户端 2.0/2.5/3.0 command 的实际稳态前进速度约为 1.75/2.14/2.52 m/s。
2.5 m/s 可作为受控试用上限，不是已证明的安全上限；它通过本轮两向交接测试，但切入姿态波动比基线更大。
不能认定扩大 command 后仍与原来同样平稳。3.0 m/s 首次交接最大倾角约28度；3.5 m/s 完整客户端直行5次中4次摔倒。
2.25 m/s 也有一次球移远压力测试中的退出交接附近失稳；在切回 AMP 前，机身已开始下坠，无法仅凭该个例归因于 AMP command 大小。
正式速度配置、交接条件、policy 权重、机器人模型和服务器物理未修改。仅新增或扩展实验脚本及隔离测试配置。
change_points_if_later_authorized: Config/NeuralNets/Dancer/amp.json: velocity_limits；当前x限幅对称，应继续保留规划层后退限制
保留转弯与横移耦合限速；本轮未支持整体等比例放大所有方向
VisualKick 的固定 command=(1,0,1) 与1.8Hz步频不受 AMP 的 velocity_limits 影响

method.straight: Each command has 5 full-client runs with >=14 s PlayOn. Body-forward speed integrated from truth position/yaw over seconds 4..9. Original repeat block 4 excluded as a whole and replaced by a fresh block after a monitor-thread lifecycle fix; one original trial only had 8.21 s PlayOn. All raw trials retained.
method.natural_handoff: Each profile: 9 trials, 14 m initial ball range, heading offsets 0/+25/-25 degrees, 3 repeats with small pose perturbations, 35 s per trial; one real B-Human player 4, no opponents, current perception/head/ownership/gate code.
method.controlled_exit: Each profile: 3 additional 20 s trials. .5 s after first foot contact, the test-only server places the ball 12 m ahead to trigger ball_out_of_range. This is a stress fixture, not a natural-match fall-rate estimate.
method.entry_window: From entry_settle start to 2 s after VisualKick entry. Residual speed is mean server truth horizontal speed during the final .1 s before policy switch. Tilt is root angle from upright.
method.exit_window: From actual VisualKick to AMP policy switch until min(2 s later, next VisualKick entry); native fall/get-up phase or physical height<.35 m or tilt>45 degrees counts as failure.
method.all_vs_first_entries: All-event totals include re-entry after a completed session. The first-entry table includes 12 initial approaches per profile.
method.direction_metrics: Handoff analysis does not use legacy kick_alignment report error_deg/success; some early reports used the native direction field. Final analysis uses physical foot contact, truth motion and policy transitions only.
limitations: 单机、有限初始姿态和短时测试，不能给出整场7v7的可靠摔倒率或证明统计等效。
未核实该ONNX准确对应训练run的command采样范围；部署限幅不等于训练或稳定性上限。
独立policy物理测试与完整客户端测试存在差异，最终建议优先依据完整客户端。
3.25 m/s虽通过5次短直行，但没有踢球衔接测试，不作为综合推荐上限。

failure_case_notes.meaning: Baseline fell about 1.54 s into its second Kick session after a session_timeout; initial high-speed entry succeeded.
Fell while VisualKick had already been active for several seconds, outside the first-entry 2 s window; no proof that enlarged AMP command caused it.
Ball-out-of-range stress exit. During exit_prepare, before AMP, height already dropped from .525 to .476 m and vertical speed reached -1.08 m/s; subsequently failed near the handoff.
